headline: Flyers activate Rasmus Ristolainen off injured reserve
take: Daily Faceoff reports the Flyers activated Rasmus Ristolainen off injured reserve after a hand injury that has cost him 16 games this season, and he wasted no time: he assisted on Travis Sanheim's tying goal in Edmonton on Wednesday. Ristolainen brings what Philadelphia's blue line has been short of, a right shot with real size and one of the hardest shots in the league (his top recorded shot is in the 98th percentile). The five-on-five results in his five games are rough, about 35% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, though five games is far too few to judge. For a 5-10-6 team allowing 3.37 expected goals an hour, getting a regular back is a start. It is not a fix.
